DECLARATION OF EXAMPLE COMMONS

ARTICLE 2 THE ASSOCIATION
2.1 Rules and Regulations.
The Board shall have the power to adopt, amend, and repeal reasonable Rules governing the use of the Common Area, provided that the Rules do not conflict with this Declaration.
2.2 Subjects.
The Rules may concern parking, pets, signs, and the keeping of vehicles.
2.3 Procedure.
The Board shall give each Member written notice of a proposed Rule at least 30 days before adopting it. A Rule may be reversed by the affirmative vote of a majority of the Total Voting Power.

ARTICLE 3 USE RESTRICTIONS
3.1 Pets.
No Owner shall keep more than two pets in a Unit. The Board may adopt and enforce pet Rules in addition to the provisions of this section.
3.2 Compliance.
Owners shall comply with the Rules adopted by the Board. A policy of title insurance shall be delivered at closing. These Rules shall remain in effect until modified by the Board.
3.3 Meetings.
A reasonable time limit for members to speak at a meeting shall be established by the Board.
3.4 Design Review.
The Design Committee may adopt design guidelines, which take effect when approved by the Board.
3.5 Parking.
Vehicles shall be parked only in a garage or a marked space. Owners may park a visitor's vehicle for up to 72 hours.
3.6 Fines.
The Board may levy a fine in accordance with a schedule of fines adopted by the Board.
3.7 Quiet Hours.
The Board has the authority to designate quiet hours.
